title: nan
authors: Matiki T.; Narazaki Y.; Chowdhary G.; Spencer B.F., Jr
key_contribution: Presents GBDTpose2, a digital twin approach matching UAV camera views with virtual cameras in a 3D CAD model using ICP over trustworthy visual-geometric regions for drift-free localization.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
